description: SEO toolset and marketing data provider for keyword research, backlink analysis, and rank tracking
auth_notes: Supports API keys for REST API access and OAuth 2.0 for third-party integrations via Ahrefs Connect.
credential_notes: API access typically requires an Enterprise subscription or paid plan, though free test queries or specific developer tiers may be available.
api_notes: Covers keyword research, backlinks, ranking tracking, and brand visibility data through a comprehensive REST API and OpenAPI spec.
mcp_notes: Ahrefs officially provides documentation and support for connecting Ahrefs data to Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients like Claude and ChatGPT.
rationale: Ahrefs has a fully documented REST API and official MCP support, but full API access generally requires a paid plan or enterprise subscription.

evidence.note: Provides overview of Ahrefs REST API, MCP support, OpenAPI spec, and Ahrefs Connect OAuth guide.
